request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

Two identical thin converging lenses are kept in contact at a distance 12.5 cm from an object. If real image produced is 4 times enlarged then what is the optical power of each lens in dioptres.

result.working: The object is at u = −12.5 cm. The image is real and 4 times enlarged, so it is inverted: m = v/u = −4, which gives v = +50 cm. Using the lens formula, 1/F = 1/v − 1/u = 1/50 + 1/12.5 = 5/50, so F = 10 cm = 0.1 m. The combined power is P = 1/0.1 = 10 D. Two identical lenses in contact have P = 2p, so each lens has p = 5 D.
